title: Get the verification of an executable
description: Checks an executable against a build record whose digest is trusted.

title: Get the verification of a source snapshot
description: Checks a source snapshot with no Git metadata against a trusted build record's source inventory.

title: Get the verification of an image
description: Checks a local or retrieved image against its record, its trusted build record and its signature.

title: List the faults of a declaration
description: Every fault of the declaration, from one strict input stage and one semantic stage, without writing a file.

title: Find every service built from a component digest
description: Every recorded service in the named checkouts that pins the digest, with the version and digest it holds, and every checkout without a readable record as unknown.

title: List the standing of each pin
description: Each pin of the service with its standing: superseded with its successor and fail date, withdrawn with its fail date, or unchecked when the lifecycle records cannot be read. Validate and plan show it.

title: Get the compiler build identity
description: The version and build identity of the running compiler, as text or as JSON.

title: List the fills for a slot
description: Every fill in the project that implements the slot, with its collection and standing. It writes nothing.

title: List the qualification of each bound fill
description: Each fill the declaration binds, with its standing and fit. Generation stops on any row that is not qualified or does not fit. It writes nothing.

title: List the drift between a record and its code
description: Every generated file that no longer matches its hash, every recorded input that changed, and whether the record is broken. It writes nothing.

title: Get the saved plan
description: Every file the saved plan would create, update or delete, whether the record changes, and whether the plan still applies. It writes nothing.

title: List what may be declared
description: Every component of an archetype's active component set, each setting with its type and allowed values, and each slot, as structured data, so an agent knows what it may write before it writes a declaration.

title: Find components by port or slot
description: The components that provide a port, require a port or offer a slot, in name order.

title: List a component's consumers
description: Every recorded service that uses one component, so a platform engineer knows who a stage change reaches before making it.

title: List missed sunsets
description: Every service that still uses a component past its sunset, with the component and the date.
